routes.name: status
routes.summary: The app version, the API version and the scope of the token used.

routes.name: schema
routes.summary: Every route with its scope and arguments, so a client can discover them.

routes.name: today
routes.summary: Today's date and the current month in the time zone set in the app.

routes.name: settings.get
routes.summary: The currency, number format, time zone and language set in the app.

routes.name: categories.list
routes.summary: The categories that are in use, oldest first, with their ids.

routes.name: transactions.list

params.name: from
params.summary: Only on or after this date.

params.name: to
params.summary: Only on or before this date.

params.name: q
params.summary: Only transactions whose name or description contains this text.

params.name: limit
params.summary: How many to return, 1 to 100. Default 50.

params.name: offset
params.summary: How many to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

routes.summary: Transactions, newest first, with the total that match. Up to 100 a page, 50 unless limit says otherwise.

routes.name: budgets.overview
routes.summary: For a month, per side (income, expense): the budget, how much of it is given to categories, what is left, and the actual so far.

routes.name: budgets.history
routes.summary: One row per month, newest first, from the first month that had a budget: the budget and the actual for each side.

routes.name: recurring.list
routes.summary: Every recurring item, with its schedule, its next due date and whether it is active.

routes.name: recurring.dues

params.name: withinDays
params.summary: How many days ahead count as upcoming, 0 to 366. Default 30.

routes.summary: Active recurring items that are overdue (due before today) and those due in the next days. Today is the date in the app's time zone.

routes.name: stats.budget
routes.summary: Budget against actual for a month: each category with its budget, what was spent or earned, what is left and the percent used, and the totals.

routes.name: stats.trend
routes.summary: One category month by month, with its budget and actual for each month. At most 120 months.

routes.name: stats.year
routes.summary: Income, expense and savings for each month of a year.

routes.name: stats.top
routes.summary: The categories with the most spending, or income, in a month, biggest first, with their share of the month.

routes.name: stats.commitments
routes.summary: What the active recurring items cost, or bring in, in an average month. Items with no fixed amount are listed but not counted.

routes.name: stats.planned
routes.summary: Planned against paid amounts of the recurring items that were paid in a month.

routes.name: settings.set

params.name: locale
params.summary: How numbers and dates are written, like en-IE.

params.name: timezone
params.summary: A time zone name, like Europe/Dublin.

params.name: language
params.summary: The language of the app, like en or ro.

routes.summary: Changes the number and date format, the time zone or the language. Give at least one. The currency is changed in the app.

routes.name: categories.create
routes.summary: Makes a category. Its name is 1 to 50 characters and unique among the categories of that type.

routes.name: categories.rename
routes.summary: Renames a category. Its type cannot change.

routes.name: categories.delete
routes.summary: Deletes a category: it is no longer offered or budgeted, and its transactions keep it.

routes.name: transactions.create

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category. Its type decides whether this is income or an expense.

params.name: clientUuid
params.summary: A fresh UUID per transaction, so a retry cannot record it twice.

routes.summary: Records a transaction. With a clientUuid, sending the same request again gives back the first transaction instead of making another.

routes.name: transactions.update

params.name: amount
params.summary: The new amount, more than zero.

params.name: description
params.summary: The new note, or null to clear it.

routes.summary: Changes a transaction. Fields left out stay as they are; a null description clears it.

routes.name: transactions.delete
routes.summary: Deletes a transaction. The change history keeps what it said.

routes.name: budgets.set

params.name: amountLimit
params.summary: The most to spend, or the aim to earn, each month. Zero is allowed.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category. Leave out for the global budget of that side.

routes.summary: Sets a monthly budget: the global budget of a side, or one category's. A month that has already started changes only that month; this month and later ones carry the new amount forward. A category budget must match the category's type.

routes.name: budgets.remove

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category. Leave out for the global budget of that side.

routes.summary: Removes a budget, with the same month rules as setting one. The months before keep it, and the history stays.

routes.name: recurring.create

params.name: amount
params.summary: The planned amount. Leave out for a bill that changes every time.

params.name: startDate
params.summary: The first due date. Later dates are worked out from it.

params.name: endDate
params.summary: The last day it can fall due.

routes.summary: Adds a recurring item: a bill or an income that comes back every so many days, weeks, months or years.

routes.name: recurring.update

params.name: amount
params.summary: The new planned amount, or null for no fixed amount.

params.name: endDate
params.summary: The new last day, or null for none.

params.name: description
params.summary: The new note, or null to clear it.

routes.summary: Changes a recurring item. Fields left out stay as they are; null clears the end date or the description, and a null amount makes it a bill with no fixed amount.

routes.name: recurring.delete
routes.summary: Deletes a recurring item. The transactions it already made stay.

routes.name: recurring.pay

params.name: amount
params.summary: What was paid. Defaults to the planned amount.

params.name: paidOn
params.summary: The day it was paid. Defaults to today in the app's time zone.

routes.summary: Turns the current occurrence into a transaction and moves the item to the next one. A bill with no fixed amount needs the amount.

routes.name: recurring.skip
routes.summary: Passes over the current occurrence without making a transaction.

routes.name: recurring.pause
routes.summary: Pauses a recurring item: it stops coming due until it is resumed.

routes.name: recurring.resume
routes.summary: Resumes a paused recurring item, unless its next date is past its end date.

routes.name: recurring.end
routes.summary: Ends a recurring item for good: it becomes inactive and its end date is today. What it already paid stays.

routes.name: export.preview

params.name: from
params.summary: Only transactions on or after this date.

params.name: to
params.summary: Only transactions on or before this date.

params.name: categoryIds
params.summary: Only these categories and what belongs to them. Leave out for all of them.

routes.summary: What an export of this selection would contain: how many transactions, their dates, the income and expense totals, and the other records.

routes.name: backup.schedule
routes.summary: The scheduled backup, if one is set up: the folder, how often and how the last one went, or null. Its passphrase is never shown.

routes.name: export.json

params.name: out
params.summary: Where to write the file: an absolute path ending in .json, in a folder that exists, that is not there yet.

params.name: from
params.summary: Only transactions on or after this date.

params.name: to
params.summary: Only transactions on or before this date.

params.name: categoryIds
params.summary: Only these categories and what belongs to them. Leave out for all of them.

routes.summary: Writes the data as a JSON file, after the person allows it in the app. An existing file is never replaced.

routes.name: export.csv

params.name: out
params.summary: Where to write the file: an absolute path ending in .csv, in a folder that exists, that is not there yet.

params.name: from
params.summary: Only transactions on or after this date.

params.name: to
params.summary: Only transactions on or before this date.

params.name: categoryIds
params.summary: Only these categories and what belongs to them. Leave out for all of them.

routes.summary: Writes the transactions as a CSV file, after the person allows it in the app. An existing file is never replaced.

routes.name: export.xlsx

params.name: out
params.summary: Where to write the file: an absolute path ending in .xlsx, in a folder that exists, that is not there yet.

params.name: from
params.summary: Only transactions on or after this date.

params.name: to
params.summary: Only transactions on or before this date.

params.name: categoryIds
params.summary: Only these categories and what belongs to them. Leave out for all of them.

routes.summary: Writes a workbook (.xlsx) with sheets for transactions, categories, budgets, recurring items and a monthly summary, after the person allows it in the app. Dates are ISO and amounts plain numbers. An existing file is never replaced.

routes.name: export.pdf

params.name: out
params.summary: Where to write the file: an absolute path ending in .pdf, in a folder that exists, that is not there yet.

params.name: toMonth
params.summary: The last month, like 2026-10. At most 120 months.

params.name: categoryIds
params.summary: Only these categories and what belongs to them. Leave out for all of them.

params.name: includeTransactions
params.summary: Also list the transactions. Up to 20,000.

params.name: showDescriptions
params.summary: Show each transaction's description. Leave off to share the report without private details.

routes.summary: Writes a PDF report for whole months, in English, after the person allows it in the app: totals, charts and budget against actual, and the transactions if asked. An existing file is never replaced.

routes.name: backup.create

params.name: out
params.summary: Where to write the file: an absolute path ending in .meowbak, in a folder that exists, that is not there yet.

params.name: passphrase
params.summary: Locks the backup. At least 8 characters. Keep it: without it the backup cannot be opened.

routes.summary: Writes an encrypted backup of all the data, after the person allows it in the app. It opens only with the passphrase given here, and only the app can restore it. An existing file is never replaced.
